title: Lazy `video` poster never loads when no media fetch is parked
body:
The [poster frame](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#poster-frame) steps park the poster fetch without starting to observe the element:

> 6. If the will lazy load element steps given the `video` return true:
>     1. Let *posterResumptionSteps* be the rest of this algorithm starting with the step labeled *Fetch*.
>     2. Set the `video` element's poster lazy load resumption steps to *posterResumptionSteps*.
>     3. Return.

The only caller of [start intersection-observing a lazy loading element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#start-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element) for media is the [resource fetch algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-media-load-resource), so the poster only loads if a media resource fetch happens to be parked at the same time. It isn't in these cases:

- `<video loading=lazy poster=p.jpg>` with no `src` and no `source` children: resource selection returns before the resource fetch algorithm, so the poster never loads.
- `<video loading=lazy poster=a.jpg src=v.mp4>`, scrolled into view and then `poster` set to `b.jpg`: the lazy load intersection observer callback already stopped observing the element, so `b.jpg` never loads.

Maybe step 6 should also start intersection-observing the element? That's a no-op if it's already observed.

cc @scottjehl
